title: Is the Deploy Bot a Person?
scenario_text: Haugesund Fintech is running an access recertification and its identity-governance tool (SailPoint) flagged an account for manager review as if it were an employee who never logs in interactively. The account is svc-deploy-prod@haugesund.io in Okta, marked profile type "Service," owner attribute "platform-team," created 2021-08-10, MFA disabled, used only by CI/CD from fixed pipeline IP ranges. SailPoint correlated it to a Workday-like HR feed because a stale integration mapped the display name "Deploy Prod" into the worker table with a fabricated employee-style ID W-00000. There is no national ID, no personal email, no benefits enrollment, no hire requisition, and no manager 1:1 history; the "manager" field was auto-filled with the platform team lead. The account holds broad production deploy entitlements. Meanwhile a real engineer, "David Roos" (Workday E-41220, national ID ending 6612, Okta droos@haugesund.io), is the registered technical owner of the service account. Security must classify svc-deploy-prod correctly: is it a human identity requiring access recertification and offboarding-on-termination, or a non-human (machine) identity requiring an accountable owner, secret rotation, and workload governance? Misclassifying it as a person would route it into leaver processes; misclassifying David's human account as a bot would exempt it from recertification. The recertification deadline is in ten days, and the classification chosen will decide which governance workflow, human-leaver or machine-credential rotation, the account is routed into.
question: How should the svc-deploy-prod@haugesund.io account be classified and governed?
choices: Treat svc-deploy-prod as an employee identity, recertify it like a person, and disable it whenever any platform-team member is terminated.

Classify svc-deploy-prod as a non-human service identity governed by an accountable human owner (David Roos), with secret rotation and workload access review, and remove the erroneous W-00000 worker mapping.
Merge svc-deploy-prod into David Roos's account droos@haugesund.io, since he owns it and that consolidates the identity.
Delete the service account immediately because service accounts should never hold production entitlements.
